patch_description:
Replace the beam search with a hybrid: a fast greedy nearest-neighbor construction (picking the transaction that increases makespan the least at each step, with several restarts from different seeds), followed by an Iterated Local Search using insertion (or-1), swap, and or-opt segment moves (blocks of length 2–3) with restart perturbation. This evaluates actual makespan via `get_opt_seq_cost` on full sequences, which is expensive, so local search only computes costs on full candidate sequences but keeps candidate generation cheap (O(n) per move type). Greedy construction gives a strong starting solution quickly; ILS with rich neighborhoods (or-opt blocks of 2–3 proven valuable in prior gens) then improves it. A time-budget-free iteration cap scaled by n keeps runtime reasonable.

Reasoning step-by-step: (1) greedy construction picks at each step the txn minimizing actual makespan increment — much faster than beam search while nearly as good; (2) multiple greedy restarts from random seeds diversify; (3) local search with insertion + swap + or-opt(2,3) removes ordering inefficiencies; (4) perturbation (random 3-swap) escapes local optima; (5) accepting only improving full solutions guarantees no regression, and we track the global best across all restarts.
